subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A chemical reaction causes a stain to spread on a laboratory surface at a rate of $125$ square centimeters per minute. What is this rate in square meters per hour? ($1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters)
explanation: Choice B is correct. Since $1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters, $1$ square meter $= 10{,}000$ square centimeters. The rate is $\frac{125 \text{ cm}^2}{1 \text{ min}} \times \frac{1 \text{ m}^2}{10{,}000 \text{ cm}^2} \times \frac{60 \text{ min}}{1 \text{ hr}} = \frac{7{,}500}{10{,}000} = 0.75$ square meters per hour.
